expected_behavior: A plan hands off to o-decompose only after scenario.mjs guard --gate layers_complete exits 0: every layer block carries its five fields, and a layer without a definition of done is refused.
Two or more approaches with trade-offs are weighed before the spec is written; a single approach is accepted only with the recorded reason no alternative is real.
Every user-facing question renders as a panel, never as a paragraph of batched questions; check-questions.mjs is the gate that refuses the prose form.

Never write over work in progress: a run whose plan still has unchecked layers gets a --new-run, never a rewrite of the old folder, and when it is unclear whether the plan is live the skill asks before touching it.
A source the user named that could not be opened is reported at the top of the next message and asked for, never worked around in silence.
A change to an approved plan is made in place and recorded under its Changelog, dated, instead of forking a new run.
